## Delivery target

Use head `preview` and base `main` for future changes; keep only these permanent remote branches. The owner normally reviews/merges. Record current fetched SHAs, synchronization and checks. A current explicit owner request may authorize a specific consolidation/merge; never assume future automatic merge permission.

## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what this change makes possible.

## Changes

Describe the final UI, workflow and integration changes included in this PR.

## Verification

List commands and actual results. Distinguish local, preview and production evidence. State checks not completed.

## Visual evidence

For visual changes, attach desktop/mobile screenshots with viewport sizes and label fictional demo data. Otherwise state not applicable.

## Setup, costs and limitations

List required configuration/migrations, remaining owner steps, provider gates and any disabled or incomplete features. No secrets or customer data.

## Credential-security review

Record the independent review, redacted staged-secret check, ignored credential paths, relevant browser/server boundaries and any remaining checks. Never paste credential values. State explicitly whether history and generated/deployed artifacts were inspected.

## Rollback

Explain how to revert the change and disable affected features safely.

Owner review and merge are required unless a current explicit request authorizes this exact merge. Do not enable auto-merge or impersonate approval. Keep only main/preview remote branches.
